name: metabase-mcp-server.codewalnut.com
description: A Metabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for integrating Metabase with AI assistants

METABASE_URL.title: Metabase URL
METABASE_URL.description: Base URL of your Metabase instance (no trailing slash). Examples: http://localhost:3000 or https://<workspace>.metabaseapp.com. Must be reachable from this machine.

METABASE_API_KEY.title: Metabase API Key
METABASE_API_KEY.description: Metabse API key often starts with “mb_…”

METABASE_MCP_AUTH_MODE.title: Authentication Mode
METABASE_MCP_AUTH_MODE.description: How the MCP server authenticates HTTP clients. Use 'static-token' for shared bearer tokens or 'none' for local stdio usage.

METABASE_MCP_AUTH_TOKENS.title: Shared Auth Tokens
METABASE_MCP_AUTH_TOKENS.description: Optional comma or newline separated static bearer tokens in the format client_id=token or token. Sensitive: do not share publicly.

METABASE_MCP_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_HTTP.title: Allow Unauthenticated HTTP
METABASE_MCP_ALLOW_UNAUTHENTICATED_HTTP.description: Permit HTTP access without auth (discouraged; only for tightly controlled networks).

METABASE_MCP_REQUIRED_SCOPES.title: Required Scopes
METABASE_MCP_REQUIRED_SCOPES.description: Optional comma or newline separated scopes that must be present on bearer tokens.

METABASE_MCP_LOG_SQL_QUERIES.title: Log SQL Queries
METABASE_MCP_LOG_SQL_QUERIES.description: Enable DEBUG logging of raw SQL (keep disabled unless you are debugging).
